title: Compare key-only replay of a USA shop recording
platforms: Linux interpreter replay model of Wine recording
changes: Compare the actual USA shop recording with and without a modeled category event while preserving the original input.
validation: Both variants reproduced all 407 serialized states identically and matched the recorded end state and clock; recording inputs, copied ROM, states and manifest hashes unchanged.
limitations: The observed category change was adjacent and included Right; the actual parser still rejects 1025, and the model bypassed that parser. No claim for nonadjacent transitions, host queues, native or GUI replay.
Managed cleanup rejects U31 units; isolated evidence remains.
